question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM humanresources.employee
author: claude-draft

question: How many employees are salaried?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM humanresources.employee WHERE salariedflag
author: claude-draft

question: What is the highest list price among all products?
gold_sql: SELECT max(listprice) FROM production.product
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders were placed in each year? Show the year and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT extract(year FROM orderdate)::int AS order_year, count(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY 1
author: claude-draft

question: How many customers are linked to a store?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales.customer WHERE storeid IS NOT NULL
author: claude-draft

question: What is the total freight charged across all sales orders?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(freight) FROM sales.salesorderheader
author: claude-draft

question: List the distinct colors that products come in, leaving out products that have no color.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT color FROM production.product WHERE color IS NOT NULL
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders were placed online?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE onlineorderflag
author: claude-draft

question: What are the names of the sales territories in the Europe group?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM sales.salesterritory WHERE "group" = 'Europe'
author: claude-draft

question: What is the average number of vacation hours among employees?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(vacationhours) FROM humanresources.employee
author: claude-draft

question: How many products does each product model have? Show the model name and the number of products.
gold_sql: SELECT m.name, count(*) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productmodel m ON m.productmodelid = p.productmodelid GROUP BY m.name
author: claude-draft

question: List the names of the products in the Mountain Bikes subcategory.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid WHERE s.name = 'Mountain Bikes'
author: claude-draft

question: What are the first and last names of the employees whose job title is Design Engineer?
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname FROM humanresources.employee e JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = e.businessentityid WHERE e.jobtitle = 'Design Engineer'
author: claude-draft

question: How many employees currently work in each department? Show the department name and the number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, count(*) FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory h JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = h.departmentid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY d.name
author: claude-draft
notes: 'Currently' means the department history row with no end date.

question: What is the total sales amount (the sum of the order totals) for each sales territory? Show the territory name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, sum(o.totaldue) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = o.territoryid GROUP BY t.name
author: claude-draft

question: List the ten most recent sales orders, newest first, with the name of the ship method used. Show the order id and the ship method name.
gold_sql: SELECT o.salesorderid, m.name FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN purchasing.shipmethod m ON m.shipmethodid = o.shipmethodid ORDER BY o.orderdate DESC, o.salesorderid DESC LIMIT 10
author: claude-draft

question: How many products does each vendor supply? Show the vendor name and the number of products.
gold_sql: SELECT v.name, count(*) FROM purchasing.productvendor pv JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = pv.businessentityid GROUP BY v.name
author: claude-draft

question: What is the average review rating of each reviewed product? Show the product name and the average rating.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, avg(r.rating) FROM production.productreview r JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = r.productid GROUP BY p.name
author: claude-draft

question: How many salespeople are assigned to each sales territory? Show the territory name and the number of salespeople.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, count(*) FROM sales.salesperson sp JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = sp.territoryid GROUP BY t.name
author: claude-draft

question: Which products have more than 1000 units on hand in total across all locations? Show the product name and the total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(i.quantity) FROM production.productinventory i JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = i.productid GROUP BY p.name HAVING sum(i.quantity) > 1000
author: claude-draft

question: List the names of the states or provinces in Canada.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM person.stateprovince s JOIN person.countryregion c ON c.countryregioncode = s.countryregioncode WHERE c.name = 'Canada'
author: claude-draft

question: List the names of the products that have never appeared on a sales order.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM production.product p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.salesorderdetail d WHERE d.productid = p.productid)
author: claude-draft

question: List the names of the product models that no product uses.
gold_sql: SELECT m.name FROM production.productmodel m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM production.product p WHERE p.productmodelid = m.productmodelid)
author: claude-draft

question: Who are the five salespeople with the highest year-to-date sales? Show first name, last name and year-to-date sales, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname, sp.salesytd FROM sales.salesperson sp JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = sp.businessentityid ORDER BY sp.salesytd DESC LIMIT 5
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders were paid with each type of credit card? Show the card type and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT c.cardtype, count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.creditcard c ON c.creditcardid = o.creditcardid GROUP BY c.cardtype
author: claude-draft

question: How many different vendors supply products in the Accessories category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT pv.businessentityid) FROM purchasing.productvendor pv JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pv.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid WHERE c.name = 'Accessories'
author: claude-draft

question: What is the total sales revenue of each product category, counting quantity times unit price after discount? Show the category name and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(d.orderqty * d.unitprice * (1 - d.unitpricediscount)) FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.name
author: claude-draft

question: Who are the five individual customers with the highest total order amount? Show first name, last name and the total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname, sum(o.totaldue) AS total FROM sales.customer c JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = c.personid JOIN sales.salesorderheader o ON o.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY pe.businessentityid, pe.firstname, pe.lastname ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
author: claude-draft

question: What is the total sales amount for each country region, going by the territory of each order? Show the country region name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT cr.name, sum(o.totaldue) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = o.territoryid JOIN person.countryregion cr ON cr.countryregioncode = t.countryregioncode GROUP BY cr.name
author: claude-draft

question: Which salesperson has handled the most sales orders? Show first name, last name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname, count(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.salesperson sp ON sp.businessentityid = o.salespersonid JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = sp.businessentityid GROUP BY pe.businessentityid, pe.firstname, pe.lastname ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1
author: claude-draft

question: Which three products sold the most units in 2024? Show the product name and units sold, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(d.orderqty) AS units FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN sales.salesorderheader o ON o.salesorderid = d.salesorderid JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid WHERE extract(year FROM o.orderdate) = 2024 GROUP BY p.productid, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3
author: claude-draft
notes: This AdventureWorks sample's orders run from 2022-05 to 2025-06, hence 2024.

question: What is the average current hourly pay rate of the employees who currently work in the Engineering department? Use each employee's most recent rate.
gold_sql: SELECT avg(ph.rate) FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory h JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = h.departmentid JOIN humanresources.employeepayhistory ph ON ph.businessentityid = h.businessentityid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL AND d.name = 'Engineering' AND ph.ratechangedate = (SELECT max(x.ratechangedate) FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory x WHERE x.businessentityid = h.businessentityid)
author: claude-draft
notes: 'Current' means the department history row with no end date; the latest rate is the one with the newest ratechangedate.

question: How many different customers have bought a product from the Bikes category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT o.customerid) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.salesorderdetail d ON d.salesorderid = o.salesorderid JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid WHERE c.name = 'Bikes'
author: claude-draft

question: How many different products were sold in orders from the Northwest sales territory?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT d.productid) FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN sales.salesorderheader o ON o.salesorderid = d.salesorderid JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = o.territoryid WHERE t.name = 'Northwest'
author: claude-draft

question: How many units were sold in each product category? Show the category name and the total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, sum(d.orderqty) FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.name
author: claude-draft

question: What are the first and last names of the employees who currently work in the Sales department?
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory h JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = h.departmentid JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = h.businessentityid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL AND d.name = 'Sales'
author: claude-draft
notes: 'Currently' means the department history row with no end date.

question: How many stores have an address of type Main Office?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT s.businessentityid) FROM sales.store s JOIN person.businessentityaddress a ON a.businessentityid = s.businessentityid JOIN person.addresstype t ON t.addresstypeid = a.addresstypeid WHERE t.name = 'Main Office'
author: claude-draft

question: What is the average list price of the products in each product category? Show the category name and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, avg(p.listprice) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.name
author: claude-draft

question: Which employees have worked in more than one department? Show first name, last name and the names of the departments they have worked in.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT pe.firstname, pe.lastname, d.name FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory h JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = h.departmentid JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = h.businessentityid WHERE h.businessentityid IN (SELECT businessentityid FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory GROUP BY businessentityid HAVING count(*) > 1)
author: claude-draft

question: Which sales reason is given most often for online orders? Show the reason name and how many orders gave it.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, count(*) AS n FROM sales.salesorderheadersalesreason x JOIN sales.salesreason r ON r.salesreasonid = x.salesreasonid JOIN sales.salesorderheader o ON o.salesorderid = x.salesorderid WHERE o.onlineorderflag GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
author: claude-draft

question: Which products in the Mountain Bikes subcategory have sold more than 100 units in total? Show the product name and total units.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(d.orderqty) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN sales.salesorderdetail d ON d.productid = p.productid WHERE s.name = 'Mountain Bikes' GROUP BY p.productid, p.name HAVING sum(d.orderqty) > 100
author: claude-draft

question: Which five vendors have been ordered the largest total quantity across all purchase orders? Show the vendor name and the quantity, largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT v.name, sum(d.orderqty) AS qty FROM purchasing.purchaseorderdetail d JOIN purchasing.purchaseorderheader h ON h.purchaseorderid = d.purchaseorderid JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = h.vendorid GROUP BY v.businessentityid, v.name ORDER BY qty DESC, v.name LIMIT 5
author: claude-draft

question: For each sales territory, which salesperson has the highest year-to-date sales? Show the territory name, first name and last name, ordered by territory name.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.name) t.name, pe.firstname, pe.lastname FROM sales.salesperson sp JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = sp.businessentityid JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = sp.territoryid ORDER BY t.name, sp.salesytd DESC
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders contain products from more than one product category?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT d.salesorderid FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid GROUP BY d.salesorderid HAVING count(DISTINCT s.productcategoryid) > 1) q
author: claude-draft

question: List each product that has a vendor standard price above 60, with the name of the vendor. Show the product name and the vendor name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, v.name FROM purchasing.productvendor pv JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pv.productid JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = pv.businessentityid WHERE pv.standardprice > 60
author: claude-draft

question: Which product in the Road Bikes subcategory has sold the most units? Show its name and the total units.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(d.orderqty) AS units FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN sales.salesorderdetail d ON d.productid = p.productid WHERE s.name = 'Road Bikes' GROUP BY p.productid, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
author: claude-draft

question: Which individual customers have placed more than 25 orders? Show first name, last name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname, count(*) FROM sales.customer c JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = c.personid JOIN sales.salesorderheader o ON o.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY pe.businessentityid, pe.firstname, pe.lastname HAVING count(*) > 25
author: claude-draft

question: How many employees currently hold each job title in each department? Show the department name, the job title and the number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, e.jobtitle, count(*) FROM humanresources.employee e JOIN humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory h ON h.businessentityid = e.businessentityid JOIN humanresources.department d ON d.departmentid = h.departmentid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY d.name, e.jobtitle
author: claude-draft
notes: 'Currently' means the department history row with no end date.

question: Which three states or provinces received the most sales orders, going by the shipping address? Show the state or province name and the number of orders, most first.
gold_sql: SELECT sp.name, count(*) AS orders FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN person.address a ON a.addressid = o.shiptoaddressid JOIN person.stateprovince sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = a.stateprovinceid GROUP BY sp.stateprovinceid, sp.name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 3
author: claude-draft

question: Which products cost more than the average list price of their own product category? Show the product name and the category name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, c.name FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid WHERE p.listprice > (SELECT avg(p2.listprice) FROM production.product p2 JOIN production.productsubcategory s2 ON s2.productsubcategoryid = p2.productsubcategoryid WHERE s2.productcategoryid = c.productcategoryid)
author: claude-draft

question: How many products are still being sold, meaning they have no sell end date?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM production.product WHERE sellenddate IS NULL
author: claude-draft

question: What is the average list price of the products that have a list price above zero?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(listprice) FROM production.product WHERE listprice > 0
author: claude-draft

question: List the names of the departments in the Manufacturing group.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM humanresources.department WHERE groupname = 'Manufacturing'
author: claude-draft

question: How many products does each product subcategory have? Show the subcategory name and the number of products.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, count(*) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid GROUP BY s.name
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders has each sales territory received? Show the territory name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN sales.salesterritory t ON t.territoryid = o.territoryid GROUP BY t.name
author: claude-draft

question: What are the first and last names of the employees hired after January 1, 2013?
gold_sql: SELECT pe.firstname, pe.lastname FROM humanresources.employee e JOIN person.person pe ON pe.businessentityid = e.businessentityid WHERE e.hiredate > '2013-01-01'
author: claude-draft
notes: Employee hire dates in this sample run from 2006 to 2013.

question: What are the names of the vendors that supply products in the Components category?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.name FROM purchasing.vendor v JOIN purchasing.productvendor pv ON pv.businessentityid = v.businessentityid JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pv.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid WHERE c.name = 'Components'
author: claude-draft

question: Which product category has the highest sales revenue, counting quantity times unit price after discount? Show the category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM sales.salesorderdetail d JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = d.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory s ON s.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory c ON c.productcategoryid = s.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(d.orderqty * d.unitprice * (1 - d.unitpricediscount)) DESC LIMIT 1
author: claude-draft

question: How many sales orders were shipped to each country region? Show the country region name and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT cr.name, count(*) FROM sales.salesorderheader o JOIN person.address a ON a.addressid = o.shiptoaddressid JOIN person.stateprovince sp ON sp.stateprovinceid = a.stateprovinceid JOIN person.countryregion cr ON cr.countryregioncode = sp.countryregioncode GROUP BY cr.name
author: claude-draft

question: What is the total purchase order subtotal for each vendor? Show the vendor name and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT v.name, sum(h.subtotal) FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader h JOIN purchasing.vendor v ON v.businessentityid = h.vendorid GROUP BY v.name
author: claude-draft
